name: Casablanca Mohammed V International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways; the longer, 17L/35R, is 3,717 m x 45 m (17R/35L is 3,711 m x 45 m)

customs.quote: Douane et contrôle des personnes / Customs and immigration H24

hours.v: ATS, fuel and handling H24; airport administration Mon-Fri 08:30-16:30 local with H24 duty cover

handling.v: handling mandatory for business and general aviation; agents listed: Jetex Executive Aviation Morocco, RAM Handling, Swissport Maroc, Morocco GHS (Groupe Globalia)
handling.quote: Handling mandatory for business and general aviation

noise.v: noise runway preference: take-offs 23:00-06:00 UTC (00:00-07:00 local at UTC+1) use RWY 17L or 17R when tailwind is 7 kt or less; jet noise-abatement climb procedure; engine tests only where the tower assigns
noise.quote: Pour les décollages de 2300-0600 UTC et avec un vent de composante arrière inférieure ou égale à 7 KT, la piste 17L ou 17R doit être utilisée.

notes: Read Morocco AIP AD 2 GMMN (SIA Maroc / ONDA), https://siamaroc.onda.ma/eaip/ad/AD2GMMN.pdf; pages dated from AIRAC AMDT 09/16 to AIRAC AMDT 03/26 (19 MAR 2026, page GMMN-14-2); text pages AD 2.3/2.4/2.12 at AMDT 03/25-09/25. No curfew, slot or PPR text found in AD 2.20-2.23 (only CFMU flow measures for start-up). Aircraft without radio and gliders prohibited. A380 (code F) assigned stand J1 per AD 2.23 (not recorded as a limit). Morocco local time is UTC+1 except during Ramadan (UTC+0). IATA code not stated in the AIP. Direct fetch of https://siamaroc.onda.ma/eaip/AD/AD2GMMN.pdf (upper-case path) was not permitted in this session; the lower-case path was read.
